Drywall FAQ

Can you match an existing wall texture?

Yes. We evaluate the existing finish and use the closest practical texture and paint process for a consistent repair.

Do you repair drywall after plumbing leaks?

Yes. After the moisture source is corrected and affected materials are dry, we can replace drywall, texture and repaint the area.
